decision: BAT-02 adds the existing jope-paths package as a direct jope-appliance edge so command handlers resolve the owner-scoped default daemon record through jope_paths::jopedime_home(). CLT-03 already added the jope-client sha2/zip edges to the base, MCP-02 already carried jope-appliance -> jope-client, and SVC-09 already carried jope-service -> jope-paths; those edges are not duplicated here. Cargo.lock is the only evaluator identity input changed by this transition; no evaluator source, behavior fixture, lineage body, DSL ABI or known identity row changes.
